quarantined_items.title: Waste Shipment Regulation
quarantined_items.summary: The EU bans plastic waste exports to non-OECD countries. The restrictions will apply until at least 21 May 2029, after which those nations may apply to receive plastic waste from the EU.
reasons: L3 high-impact second review (same evidence, not independent confirmation): partially_supported (confidence 0.70); The interpretation introduces new factual claims not present in the source: that the ban may shift plastic waste volumes towards EU recyclers and converters, and that brand owners may need to review export routes for plastic packaging waste.
